d:
Gold Rush puts the miners up against some of their toughest challenges yet, as nature threatens to bring their operations to a halt. From drought-hit claims and muddy terrain to frozen ground and freezing temperatures, every crew must find a way to keep mining through the harsh conditions. With heavy machinery struggling and valuable pay gravel trapped beneath the frozen ground, can the miners overcome nature's challenges before the season slips away?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 6, Episodes 4, 2, 11, 6, 19, 13, 9, 16 and 18, on Discovery Channel India.
